title: Methylocystis intestini and the role of gut methanotrophs in intestinal methane, peristalsis, and fat metabolism
core_idea: Isolate and characterize a previously unreported human gut methanotroph (Methylocystis intestini), determine its methane-oxidizing capacity and genomic features, and test whether administering or colonizing the gut with this methanotroph can modulate methane-driven changes in intestinal peristalsis and fat metabolism in experimental models, while surveying metagenomic datasets for prevalence of methane-oxidation genes.
tldr: The study investigates a newly isolated human gut methanotroph, evaluates its methane-oxidation potential and effects on methane-associated intestinal motility and fat metabolism in models, and examines the global prevalence of methane-oxidation genes in human fecal metagenomes.
